title: Console SignalBoard: compact onboarding screenshots (latency / cost / trace overlays)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of onboarding / quickstart visual assets for the Console onboarding flow focused on the new 'SignalBoard' concept: a condensed observability landing card that surfaces 3 core signals (p50/p95 latency sparkline, cost-per-token trend, and a mini trace timeline with annotations). Assets will be used in the docs quickstart, in-app first-run carousel, and marketing one-pagers. Goal is to give new users a single glance view of health + cost tradeoffs and clickable hotspots that link to deeper traces and the cost breakdown panel.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero PNGs exported (desktop wide, tablet landscape, mobile narrow) in both light and dark themes
Annotated redline PDF for dev handoff describing responsive breakpoints, padding, and accessible color tokens
Figma file with named components for: SignalBoardCard, LatencySparkline, CostTrend, TraceMiniView, Hotspot overlays
In-app first-run carousel screenshot set (3 frames) integrated with copy from PM and localization placeholders
QA checklist completed: visual diff run, contrast passes AA, assets sized per CDN requirements
Engineering sign-off from ENG-31244 on trace mini view export format and overlay interaction mapping
